chunks: 5840 - And Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān narrated from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام that he said:
"Being well-known for worship is a source of suspicion. My father narrated to me from his father, from his grandfather عليهم السلام, that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:"

"The most worshipful of people is the one who upholds the obligations; the most generous of people is the one who pays the zakat of his wealth; the most ascetic of people is the one who avoids the haram; the most God-fearing of people is the one who speaks the truth concerning what is for him and against him; the most just of people is the one who is pleased for people with what he is pleased for himself and dislikes for them what he dislikes for himself; the wisest of people is the one who remembers death most intensely; the most enviable of people is the one who is beneath the earth, having become safe from punishment and hoping for reward; the most heedless of people is the one who does not take admonition from the world's changing from one state to another; the greatest of people in the world in worth is the one who gives no worth to the world in his own regard; the most knowledgeable of people is the one who adds the knowledge of people to his own knowledge; the bravest of people is the one who overcomes his desire; the most valuable of people is the one with the most knowledge; the least valuable of people is the one with the least knowledge; the least delighted of people is the envious one; the least comfortable of people is the miser; the stingiest of people is the one who is miserly with what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made obligatory upon him; the person most entitled to the truth is the one most knowledgeable of it; the least sacred of people is the transgressor; the least loyal of people is the owned servant; the one with the fewest friends is the king; the poorest of people is the covetous one; the richest of people is the one who is not a captive of greed; the best of people in faith is the one with the best character; the most honorable of people is the most God-fearing of them; the greatest of people in rank is the one who leaves what does not concern him; the most scrupulous of people is the one who leaves disputation even if he is right; the least manly of people is the one who is a liar; the most wretched of people are kings; the most detested of people is the arrogant one; the most strenuous of people in exertion is the one who abandons sins; the soundest in judgment of people is the one who flees from the ignorant among people; the happiest of people is the one who associates with the noble among people; the most intelligent of people is the one most given to courteous forbearance with people; the person most deserving of suspicion is the one who sits with the people of suspicion; the most rebellious of people is the one who kills someone other than his killer or strikes someone other than his striker; the person most worthy of pardon is the one most able to punish; the person most deserving of sin is the foolish backbiter; the most humiliated of people is the one who humiliates people; the most resolute of people is the one who most suppresses anger; the most righteous of people is the one most beneficial to people; and the best of people is the one through whom people benefit."

key_terms.التُّهَمَةِ: suspicion or a setting that exposes one to blame
key_terms.الْفَرَائِضَ: the obligatory religious duties a believer must uphold
key_terms.ذِكْرًا لِلْمَوْتِ: active remembrance of death as a moral discipline
key_terms.زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ: the obligatory alms due from one’s wealth

ai.seo_question: What qualities make a person the best, most God-fearing, and most honorable in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gathers concise ethical teachings attributed to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, transmitted through the Imams عليهم السلام. It defines true excellence in worship, character, knowledge, justice, self-restraint, and social conduct, while warning against greed, arrogance, envy, falsehood, and sinful companionship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5840 - Yunus ibn Zabyan narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), that he said:
"Being well-known for worship is a source of suspicion. My father Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), narrated to me from his father Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as), from his grandfather Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), peace be upon them, that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
'The most devout of people, is the one who upholds the obligatory acts.
The most generous of people, is the one who pays the zakat on his wealth.
The most ascetic of people, is the one who avoids what is forbidden.
The most God-fearing of people, is the one who speaks the truth, whether it is for or against him.
The most just of people, is the one who is pleased for others with what he is pleased for himself and dislikes for them what he dislikes for himself.
The wisest of people, is the one who remembers death the most.
The most enviable of people, is the one who is under the earth (in the grave) but safe from punishment and hoping for reward.
The most heedless of people, is the one who does not learn from the changing states of the world.
The greatest in status in this world, is the one who considers the world to have no worth to him.
The most knowledgeable of people, is the one who gathers the knowledge of others along with his own.
The bravest of people, is the one who overcomes his desires.
The most valuable of people, is the one with the most knowledge.
The least valuable of people, is the one with the least knowledge.
The least delighted of people, is the envious person.
The least comfortable of people, is the miser.
The stingiest of people, is the one who withholds what Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has made obligatory.'"
Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"The person most entitled to the truth is the one most knowledgeable of it.
The least respected among people, is the sinner.
The least loyal among people, is the servant.
The one with the fewest friends, is the king.
The poorest of people, is the one consumed by greed.
The richest of people, is the one who is not enslaved by desire.
The best in faith among people, is the one with the best character.
The most honorable of people, is the most God-conscious.
The greatest in status among people, is the one who abandons what does not concern him.
The most pious of people, is the one who avoids argumentation, even when he is right.
The least dignified among people, is the liar.
The most wretched of people, are kings.
The most hated of people, is the arrogant.
The most diligent of people, is the one who abandons sins.
The wisest of people, is the one who avoids ignorant people.
The happiest of people, is the one who associates with honorable people.
The most intelligent of people, is the one who deals most patiently with people.
The most deserving of suspicion, is the one who keeps the company of suspicious people.
The most rebellious of people, is the one who kills someone who did not kill him or strikes someone who did not strike him.
The person most worthy of forgiveness, is the one most capable of punishment.
The most deserving of blame, is the foolish backbiter.
The most humiliated of people, is the one who humiliates others.
The most composed of people, is the one who suppresses anger the most.
The most righteous of people, is the one who is most beneficial to others.
And the best of people, is the one from whom people benefit."
